lhs: Reduce a broadcast along a subset of its mapped target axes.
rhs: Reduce corresponding base axes, then broadcast the surviving base axes at each old target minus the number of preceding deleted target axes.
conditions: Strictly increasing equal-extent broadcast map, arbitrary finite static shapes including zeros and rank zero, single-output logical ordered fold, any subset of mapped axes selected.
types: Any element type, same on both sides, pure binary reducer, arbitrary initializer.
overlap: Different from reducing newly introduced axes or eliminating an empty reduction; equal-extent HLO broadcast, excluding client-level mapped singleton expansion.
